notes.title: Super Footbrawl Status Update
notes.content:
I heard the words “abandoned project” several times now and even the Steam ratings are getting worse and worse because people waiting/expecting an update for footbrawl/playground – which is completely understandable.

At the moment there is nothing I can do about the lack of updates, news for this game. Jon is working really hard to finish everything and also reaching a good quality at the same time – I am extreme sorry for the current situation and there is nothing I or he can do to finish the Ai faster since its just a pretty big task which requires time.

All I can promise you is, that there will be an Update in the next 1-3 Months and it will blow you away! Footbrawl is not Shovel ware and i hope you have still a bit patience 🙂

one more thing, i think i made the mistake to not link the last Devblog posts at the Steam Page. so please check out; 
http://pixelpizza.de/wordpress/?p=920
http://pixelpizza.de/wordpress/?p=991
http://pixelpizza.de/wordpress/?p=1005

which maybe explains a bit why everything takes so long but of course, is not an excuse!

notes.title: Footbrawl Playground is now on Steam!
notes.content:
Thanks everybody for voting yes... and also thanks to those who voted for no ;) 

You can Finaly buy Footbrawl Playground here on Steam! If you already bought it already on itch.io you will receive a key in the next days/weeks. Please bear with me that it might take a little bit time since i have to send out each key by hand

The steam Version is the Version 004beta2 from itch.io - you can see the Changelog here: 

[list]
[*]Added Gamepad Support - only tested with XBOX Controller
[*]Press "Start" to join the Game
[*]Press "Select" to view controls
[*]Added 4 Player Support - not! tested!
[*]added a giant Hand...? pretty expermiental. Press the C key to disable the controls(to use the menu again for example). To activate the hand, click on "Hand" in the Menu
[*]Addded a Multitrack Camera, The Multitrack Camera is very experimental. If you rotate the Cam in the Orbit/Player/Ball mode and then switch to the Multicam, it will break. So if you wanna use it, restart the game (esc key) dont move the camera. and press the multicam button
[*]Fixed the "human centipede" bug where characters could somehow run inside each other
[*]since the Explosive Barrels are eating too much performance, you can now only spawn one on each Button press(disabled holding down of the key)
[*]added a 32 and 64 bit version for windows. not sure what the version before where. so either way 32 bit user can play the game now or 64bit users will have a performance boots ¯\_(ツ)_/¯
[/list]

I hope you enjoy the Game!
